summary: Set up the @gizmo/orchestration package (manifest, tsconfig, barrel, agent-dir helper reading PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR), then copied the search-and-scrape/subagents/workflows extensions into a new extensions/ tree under the registry, rewriting shared/* and pi-declarative-ui imports to point at packages/orchestration/src and re-routing internal manager/controller/etc. imports to src/ subfolders. Also rewrote context-utilization.test.ts to vitest style and began adding an index.ts and a web barrel (with SearchToolResult/ScrapeToolResult components) for search-and-scrape.
decisions: Agent directory is resolved via process.env.PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR only, mirroring @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent's getAgentDir (ENV_AGENT_DIR = `${APP_NAME.toUpperCase()}_CODING_AGENT_DIR`).

Tests in the orchestration package use vitest (vitest run script, @earendil-works/... devDeps list vitest 4.1.11); context-utilization.test.ts was rewritten with expect(...).toBe(...) instead of node:test/assert.
Ported extension sources are organized as extensions/<name>/pi-extension.ts + src/{server,web}/, so pi-extension.ts imports now use ./src/... and shared/* imports point at packages/orchestration/src.
Scrape tool details were enriched with bounded markdown_preview and markdown_length so the web card (which only sees `details`) can show a snippet without the full markdown.
errors: pnpm install aborted initially with ERR_PNPM_ABORTED_REMOVE_MODULES_DIR_NO_TTY; resolved by setting CI=true.
Subsequent pnpm install timed out after 300s; a retry with 900s timeout failed with EPERM unlink on node_modules/.pnpm/@esbuild+win32-x64@0.28.2/.../esbuild.exe (likely a holding process).
